title: Inside Out
lyrics:
[00:29.99]Will I be able to speak
[00:34.08]After a stiff drink?
[00:43.94]Would it break my panic?
[00:49.96]Would the sweat stop pouring out?
[00:57.41]Slow and deliberate
[01:04.01]With her words
[01:11.00]She'll walk through
[01:17.37]My heart
[01:24.96]Those eyes light a fire
[01:31.42]In the stomach
[01:37.88]Fall apart
[01:45.00]From the inside out
